mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_device(tenant_id, product_key, device_name, display_name, device_type, secret, status, protocol_type, protocol_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{productKey}, #{deviceName}, #{displayName}, #{deviceType}, #{secret}, #{status}, CASE WHEN #{protocolType} IS NULL OR #{protocolType} = '' THEN 'MQTT_ALINK_JSON' ELSE #{protocolType} END, #{protocolVersion}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, product_key, device_name, display_name, device_type, secret, status, protocol_type, protocol_version, created_at, updated_at FROM iot_device WHERE product_key = #{productKey} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE iot_device SET display_name = #{displayName}, device_type = CASE WHEN #{deviceType} IS NULL OR #{deviceType} = '' THEN device_type ELSE #{deviceType} END, protocol_type = CASE WHEN #{protocolType} IS NULL OR #{protocolType} = '' THEN protocol_type ELSE #{protocolType} END, protocol_version = CASE WHEN #{protocolVersion} IS NULL OR #{protocolVersion} = '' THEN protocol_version ELSE #{protocolVersion} END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_key = #{productKey} AND device_name = #{deviceName}
